standard_prerequisites: Context span 4040-4096: G = (mu_{2,k})^infty = lim (mu_{2,k})^n, an affine group scheme with k[t_1, t_2, ...]/(t_i^2 - 1); the torsor P = Spec(k[x_1, x_2, ...]/(x_i^2 - a_i)) with G-action x_i -> t_i  tensor  x_i, which is a G-principal space (over k' = k(sqrt a_1, ...) it becomes G-equivariantly isomorphic to G) and is an fppf torsor if and only if k'/k is finite (forward via the fppf covering Spec(k'), backward via a closed point of a trivilizing cover and Varieties, lemma-locally-finite-type-Jacobson); explicit example k = Q, a_i = i gives k'/k infinite
Examples of Stacks subsections defining G-Principal and G-Torsors
core_obligations: For k = Q and a_i = i the context gives a principal homogeneous G-space P which is not an fppf G-torsor (k'/k infinite, criterion above)
Hence the functor G-Torsors -> G-Principal is not essentially surjective in general
Therefore the two stacks are not equivalent
proof_roadmap: Instantiate the context example over Q
Apply the fppf criterion: P is principal but not an fppf torsor
